remarks: 61.43 Acres of untouched land in North Stamford, CT. This one parcel for sale provides a great opportunity to build a private estate or develop a future subdivision. The property was previously subdivided into 18 lots ranging in size from 2 acres to 5+ acres. There are three access points to the property: Rock Rimmon Road, Coventry Road & Boulderol Road. 15 Minutes to Downtown Stamford, 25 minutes to Westchester County Airport, 55 Minutes to New York City. Additional documents regarding previous subdivision are available.
